evidence.reason: At current lines 997-998, `observed` is set only from list length and `new_runs` is sliced using that length. A same-length but changed `after_runs` prefix yields `observed = true` and an empty `new_runs`, so `run_log_observed_after_*` and `no_new_service_after_*` can pass despite a new service run being present. Requiring `after_runs[:len(before_runs)] == before_runs` and treating a changed/truncated prefix as non-passing is the smallest correctness fix.
